text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
No freakin' way~~!! Is this a dream?!
This literally looks straight outta a TV drama!!
Seriously, thanks a million for inviting me!!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Tone down the hype a bit! 
Pfft, is it really that insane?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: (...I'm glad I invited her.)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
(I'm always bailing on her last-minute.
I felt bad for Jordan, so for once...)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Jordan, you free this Saturday?
There's an event, wanna come?
I got invited through some work stuff.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, what? Can I seriously come too?!
I'm totally free! I wanna go so bad!!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
(Sweet... she looks super hyped about it.
Now all I gotta do is treat her like a VIP on the day...!)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Let's grab some food first. The buffet
is catered by a famous chef from overseas.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
For real?!
And all of this is totally free?! Are you insane?!

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, City-san.
It's been a while. Has it been since the photoshoot?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ah, long time no see. Thank you so much for
everything back then. It was a wonderful shoot.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Whoa, instant work mode...!!

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it... I saw the director
earlier. Would you like to come say hello together?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Right, well... yes, absolutely.
I know he's busy, so just a quick greeting...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Phew, I think that's everyone on staff.
...Wait, shoot. Jordan...!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
(I was supposed to show her around the buffet...
What the heck am I doing...?!)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Holy crap, what is this?! It's insanely good!!
Today is officially a super cheat day...!!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Jordan, I'm so sorry!!
The greetings took way too long...!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, City! Dude, this food is on another level!
Famous chefs are no joke!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, stop apologizing and hurry up and eat!
I grabbed enough for both of us!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...No, let me apologize properly. For real.
Like... sorry for leaving you alone.
I promised myself I wouldn't do this today.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
Wait, what? What're you talking about...?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...I wanted to make up for always blowing off our plans.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I'm always ditching last-minute.
I've been causing you so much trouble...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
No way, you can't help that!
It's your job, so it's not like it's your fault, right?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: If anything, watching you just now felt totally showbiz-pro, you looked super cool! City, you're the best!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Jordan...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Sure, there're times where I feel like you didn't explain the cancel enough. But that's just 'cause you're busy.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
That's why we made that promise, right?
That I'd just ask whenever I get worried.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
So seriously, don't sweat it!
I'm having the absolute best time right now!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Jordan...
I'm always so sor—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
(No, that's not it.
That's not what I should say...)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much for everything, Jordan.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hehe, thank YOU too!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Heh. Guess it's time for a fresh start then.
I'm gonna be the best guide you could ask for from here on out.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day—I caught sight of Gold City near the school gates with a gentle expression on her face.
choice_data_list: Good morning. You seem to be in a good mood.
Good morning. You seem to be in a good mood.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, Trainer. Hey.
Yeah, guess so.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
About that Jordan stuff before.
Things worked out in our own way, I guess.
Felt like that's all that really matters.
choice_data_list: Friendship comes in all shapes and sizes.
I hope your friendship grows even deeper.
I hope your friendship grows even deeper.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
About that Jordan stuff before.
Things worked out in our own way, I guess.
Felt like that's all that really matters.
choice_data_list: Friendship comes in all shapes and sizes.
I hope your friendship grows even deeper.
I hope your friendship grows even deeper.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Right?
We'll just do things our own way. Thanks.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Gold City answered with a composed, dignified expression.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Totally. Well...
We'll be fine, no doubt.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Gold City answered with an expression brimming with confidence.
